kind: PRE-REGISTRATION (written before experiments E1-E3 were run)
question: Can a dot field built from a single structural prior, placed off the known catalogue with a 2-px exclusion (the H33 B2 rule), be unique versus the nine focus-site TIFFs and beat the H33 B2 value on the SGMC-CAL proxy?
why_this_proxy: Across the nine focus files, the prevalence-calibrated SGMC off-catalogue DTI (evaluate_sgmc_with_ci) ranks the owner-reported leaderboard values with Spearman 0.95 (n=9; owner values UNVERIFIED). The catalogue hide-and-recover holdout ranks them with Spearman -0.85, i.e. it is anti-aligned, so it is NOT used as the selection target.

budget.E3: candidate KS3-strain (single ablation of the prior)

KS3-ridge.prior: Hessian ridge response (largest-magnitude negative eigenvalue) of the rtp band (band 2, magnetic reduced-to-pole), Gaussian sigma=1.5 px, z-scored over footprint
KS3-ridge.selection: greedy descending-prior pick, suppression radius 4 px (Chebyshev-free Euclidean)
KS3-ridge.uses_catalogue_only_for: 2-px exclusion and the pixel-exact label mask; never as a feature

KS3-strain.prior: geod_shearrate (band 7) z-scored over footprint, Gaussian sigma=1.5 px

leakage_rule: Each feature alone is evaluated for AUC against withheld-catalogue truth on the vendored holdout cells; AUC > 0.90 means leakage until disproved.
decision_rules: A candidate is valid only if format checks, dot-overlap < 70% within 3 px and Spearman < 0.90 hold against every focus-site TIFF.
Promotion as the recommended file requires SGMC-CAL point estimate above H33 B2 (0.0641 computed here) with non-overlapping-or-explained CI; otherwise the verdict is negative.
The catalogue hide-and-recover value is reported for transparency and is NOT a selection criterion.
No weekly slot is spent by this work; the organizer leaderboard value is unknown until a receipt exists.
named_non_fault_mimics: Magnetic ridges from lithologic contacts, intrusive margins or topographic/terrain-correlated noise in rtp (KS3-ridge).
Strain-rate artefacts from flight-line or gridding geometry in the GeoDAWN-derived geod_* bands (KS3-strain).
